Force Barrier I

Sorcerer · Level 1 · Self Alteration

Effect

Creates a barrier around you for 60 min. The barrier increases armor class by 24. Absorbs 1 attack and stuns the attacker for 3 seconds every 30 seconds.

As it was earlier

rows.detail_main_html:
Seradon's Mantle of Perception I

Sorcerer · Level 1

Effect

Fills your target's group with power. +14 Intelligence +19 Fire Resist +19 Cold Resist +28 Arcane Resist +13 Shadow Resist +13 Holy Resist +3 Spell Identification Rebalanced except for Int, SR, and HR

Notes

No cost is shown on this tooltip, and none appeared after the player delevelled — unlike the rest of the class, where costs were hidden at one level and visible at another. So this may genuinely have no cost. Worth a developer confirming that is intended rather than a missing value: every other group buff in the game costs something to cast.

Previously recorded by the vgoplayers wiki as: “TGB : INT, Fire resist, Cold resist, Arcane resist, Shadow resist, Holy resist, spell identification” (https://web.archive.org/web/20220517105351id_/https://vgoplayers.com/wiki/index.php/Sorcerer)

Read from the in-game tooltip in VGO Emulator. Bracketed damage figures shown in game are the skill- and level-adjusted values for that character and are not recorded here.

Flame Spear I

Sorcerer · Level 16 · Fire Evocation

Effect

Sends a fiery spear towards your target dealing 689 to 731 damage and 237 to 253 damage over 4 seconds. Deals an extra 1011 to 1069 damage on a critical strike.

As it was earlier

What guides written while Vanguard was running recorded for this ability. Kept beside the current figures rather than replacing them — the game was rebalanced across its life, so both are right for their own year.

16

Ten Ton Hammer class guides, 2007-2008 · every ability that changed

Sleep I

Sorcerer · Level 18 · Arcane Alteration

Effect

Puts an opponent to sleep for 30 sec. The slumber will only last until hit and you may only have 1 target asleep at a time. After 4 sec, a sleeping target will begin to regenerate life.

As it was earlier

What guides written while Vanguard was running recorded for this ability. Kept beside the current figures rather than replacing them — the game was rebalanced across its life, so both are right for their own year.

rows.detail_main_html:
Seradon's Mantle of Perception III

Sorcerer · Level 20

Effect

Fills your target's group with power. +56 Intelligence +54 Fire Resist +54 Cold Resist +110 Arcane Resist +50 Shadow Resist +50 Holy Resist +7 Spell Identification Rebalanced except for Int, SR, and HR.

Notes

No cost is shown on this tooltip, and none appeared after the player delevelled — unlike the rest of the class, where costs were hidden at one level and visible at another. So this may genuinely have no cost. Worth a developer confirming that is intended rather than a missing value: every other group buff in the game costs something to cast.
